title: Schedule of Service Charges Note — The Reconnect Fee on Electric Service by Rate Schedule
content:
**Charge.** An Electric Service by Rate Schedule account disconnected for nonpayment is reconnected at the member's request, and the reconnection bills one reconnect fee on the account. The fee is billed on the next bill and is never collected as a condition of reconnection.

**Amount.** The reconnect fee is the crew charge, rounded to the cent. The crew charge is the schedule's business-hours truck reconnect fee — the charge of a crew truck sent during business hours, as listed on the reconnect fee schedule.

### Figures by schedule (from the reconnect fee schedule)

| Schedule | Reconnect fee |
|---|---|
| Schedules R, RS, FH and GS-1 | $75.00 |
| Schedules GS-3 and IR | $110.00 |
| Schedule LP | $185.00 |

### Hypothetical cases

| Account | Reconnect fee billed on the next bill |
|---|---|
| Schedule FH farm home reconnected | $75.00 |
| Schedule GS-3 bin site reconnected | $110.00 |
| Schedule LP elevator reconnected | $185.00 |

### Points of judgement

- One reconnection bills one reconnect fee.
- The fee is not part of what the member pays to be reconnected; it appears on the following bill.
